_description: Event calendar (roadmap Phase 7; event_calendar.py). Each event: name, date ranges ('periods': every year MM-DD, only that year YYYY-MM-DD, relative to a holiday easter/chinese_new_year/thanksgiving_day±N; after 'known_calendar' the runs of the last 52 weeks repeat; or weekly 'days' 0=Monday and 'hours'), the event types announced to the client in EventUpdateCommand ('kinds': the EventModule.type names in the recording), achievement groups ('achievement': data/achievements.json group or event name). Dates are the real game's 2023-2026 runs since E8 (tools/calendar_e8.py); event aliens spawn in the map section's 'hours' (the panel's session_always_open setting removes them). The player can turn an event on regardless of its date: game.py --event halloween,agatus (all: --event all; to turn the seasonal ones off: --event none).

continuous._description: Feature flags that appear as indefinite (210,030 hours) in the recording; those the server has an equivalent for, or that change the client's behavior, are sent as is.

The Payment section's Inferno Berserker and the player conversion achievements are out of scope; single past period: can be started from the panel

europa_ranking.name: Global 4 - Europa Ranking
europa_ranking._source: Official Turkish forum 177655 (Universal 4 - Europa ranking event, 29 October 11:00 - 28 November 2025): participation reward (Europa Vanguard) for everyone who logs in during the event, reward by level and EP rank (top 5 Europa Conqueror; 'Titan Fatihi' in the forum's 3rd row is a typo); rewards are given when the event ends (EventRewardConfirmationCommand instead of the claim window). In single-player the pilot is 1st; single past period: can be started from the panel

tenth_anniversary.name: DarkOrbit 10th Anniversary
tenth_anniversary._source: official Turkish forum 126560 (10th Anniversary, 1-31 December 2016): 13 story quests (506217-506229; 506222 has no title in the client), 16 daily quests (506201-506216) in quest_extras; the Demaner renewal is demaner_hunt, the Winter Calendar and Goliath-X already exist. Three side quests have no id in the client: not added; single past period: can be started from the panel
